_comment: Control 9 - the most valuable control and the hardest to express. Aliases: Microsoft.Web/sites/config/web.ipSecurityRestrictionsDefaultAction and .../ipSecurityRestrictions[*]. VERIFY BOTH. The rule flags a web app whose default action is not Deny, i.e. reachable from anywhere regardless of what allow rules exist. It deliberately does NOT try to validate the X-Azure-FDID header contents - that is checked by the bypass test in tests/, not by policy.
displayName: App Service must deny public access by default (origin lockdown)
description: A WAF that can be bypassed is not a control. A web app behind Front Door or Application Gateway must refuse traffic that did not arrive through it.
